ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level bimodal distribution; approximately 45% low-intensity (black) coverage concentrated on the left lobe and 55% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated on the right lobe and peripheral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Primary contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering the interior surface area. Right lobe: Broad high-intensity (white) field with localized low-intensity (black) linear and punctate clusters. Outer margins of both lobes exhibit high-intensity speckling on low-intensity backgrounds.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~1:2 within the notch bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the full trailing edge; notable deep amplitude notch (void) located approximately 40% from the left tip toward the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins follow a convex trajectory from the peduncle base to the tips, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered high-intensity circular pixel groups (rosettes) located at the distal tips of both lobes and extending along the upper-left trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the trailing edge toward the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe indicating potential previous physical trauma or tissue loss; presence of dense barnacle-typical clusters at tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in global pigmentation, where the left lobe is almost entirely low-intensity and the right lobe is predominantly high-intensity.
